Balanced: 30 fps / 4.5 Mbps. High-performance: 60 fps / 10 Mbps; still real-time export.

Optional fast desktop export · cuts only

For high-end Windows PCs: save a MangoShot project JSON, keep the matching original video and run the bundled Node + FFmpeg helper. GPU H.264 encoding is attempted when available. This separate tool cannot render text/callout layers and refuses those projects.

node tools/fast-render.mjs --source "input.mp4" --project "MangoShot-Project.json" --output "edited.mp4" --encoder auto

Needs Node.js and FFmpeg on your PC. This local helper may render faster than real time; the browser exporter remains real-time.

Connection & permissions
Load a video and pause playback. Select what a trusted local MCP client may request. No files, microphone, desktop or shell access.







Install the separate companion first. No listener starts until you pair.


Reveal local MCP client configuration (secret)
Replace the example executable path with your installed bridge. Paste only into a trusted local client. Re-pair after restarting that client; the secret expires at the session deadline.


Connect to ChatGPT
Pair the local companion first.
Use OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel. No public inbound listener is required. Create a private tunnel associated with your ChatGPT workspace and a restricted runtime API key with Tunnels Read + Use. Do not paste keys into ChatGPT.
Pairing port: —. Reveal the local configuration for the token, then enter it and the OpenAI runtime key only in the launcher. The launcher checks local pairing and tunnel readiness. Stop it with Ctrl+C.
When the launcher reports ready, open ChatGPT → Plugins → + → Add custom MCP server → Connection: Tunnel. Select your tunnel, configure authentication, and test inspect_project with inspection scope granted. Keep the editor and launcher open.
Local MCP activity is not proof of ChatGPT connectivity. Confirm a representative call from your own plugin before publishing. Only trusted private users should be authorized for this tunnel.

Only the displayed JPEG is shared after approval. Review for private information.


Sequence approval is a single undoable transaction. Changing the source, revoking permission or disconnecting cancels requests. Approved frame data is consumed once and expires after 60 seconds.
